Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness.
When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.
The tempter came and said to him.
Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain.
He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,
Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.
Be careful that you don't do your charitable giving before men.
Therefore when you do merciful deeds, don't sound a trumpet.
But when you do merciful deeds, don't let your left hand know.
